rationale: Discharge-only schedule maximizing total battery energy subject to SOC>=2.5 MWh, battery step 2 MW, and diesel pmin=12 MW. Total battery discharge 26 MW reduces diesel from a net-load sum of 119 MW to 93 MW. SOC ends at 2.59 MWh (>=2.5), diesel stays within [12,55] MW, no PV curtailment and no load shedding. Cost = 93 MW * (1/12) h * 92 $/MWh = 713.0 USD.
